fitAssessments.summary: Mixed-facing three-across photographed in related Essential; your Maxi-Cosi needs a trial.

arrangement.detail: Essential photos show a rear-facing InfaSecure capsule beside two forward-facing harnessed seats. Exact model suffixes are unstated.

buckles.detail: No demonstrated daily booster-buckle access with neighbouring restraints. A physically packed three-seat photo would not establish this.

space.detail: Author reports a 182-cm driver ahead of a rear-facing seat; confirm your Dynamic/Extended and larger convertible.

access.detail: Three rear restraint positions and two outboard ISOFIX pairs are documented. The handbook requires cargo-cover removal to access outboard tethers. A daily child-loading trial with all three remains pending.

fitAssessments.summary: Three rear tethers and two outer ISOFIX pairs; rear-facing clearance observed in related Performance, but no reliable matching three-across trial.

arrangement.detail: Target: one rear-facing plus two forward-facing seats/boosters. No verified matching simultaneous installation. Community powered-door test appears to be Performance; the named b-grow seat is forward-facing-only, so its rear-facing claim cannot establish a safe combination.

buckles.detail: No independent daily booster-buckle access test with all three restraints installed.

space.detail: A New Zealand Performance road test installed a rear-facing toddler seat without moving the front passenger seat. Driver height and restraint model are unstated. This supports clearance only, not a RWD three-across arrangement.

access.detail: Exact standard RWD long-term test confirms rear doors open 90 degrees, helping child-seat loading. Rear-facing installation still needs a household trial.

access.detail: Related standard RWD long-term test confirms rear doors open 90 degrees; Australian brochure shows both rear-drive grades without powered automatic doors. Trial loading with your rear-facing seat.

fitAssessments.summary: Three rear tether positions documented; related European Evo has useful door access. Mixed three-across remains a fitting question.

arrangement.detail: Australian brochure specifies three rear tethers and two outboard ISOFIX pairs. Overseas front-seat ISOFIX equipment must not be assumed Australian. No verified Evo mixed three-across trial; earlier Atto 3 testing is a different cabin specification.

space.detail: Front clearance with an occupied rear-facing restraint untested.

access.detail: European RWD Evo road test reports reasonably wide rear-door openings for child-seat loading. This is related body/access evidence, not an Australian three-restraint or front-seat installation test.

fitAssessments.summary: S6 Hybrid Sport demonstrates the facing mix; the petrol base is related evidence.

arrangement.detail: July 2025 Hybrid Sport fitted two forward-facing seats and one rear-facing behind the driver. Exact restraint models unreported; centre booster compatibility still matters.

buckles.detail: No occupied three-restraint booster-buckling trial. ANCAP rejects one selected centre booster, tested alone.

space.detail: July mixed-seat trial allowed a 186 cm driver. Preview with a different 0–4 rear-facing convertible allowed 180 cm; recline and model affect clearance.

access.detail: Sixth-generation UK review reports big rear doors and straightforward bulky-child-seat fitting. Australian Hybrid Sport has accessible anchors in the mixed-seat trial; exact base-petrol loading remains untested.

fitAssessments.summary: Three rear tether positions; original AWD mixed-seat trial is useful background. Revised-seat clearance, three-across and buckle use require a fitting check.

arrangement.detail: Current Australian specification verifies two outer ISOFIX pairs and three rear tethers. The original AWD has a photographed mixed three-seat installation, but revised 84-kWh seats have no matched trial.

space.detail: Exact base review finds generous adult rear space and a flat footwell. Earlier AWD demonstrated 180–186 cm front clearance with its rear-facing Attain More, but revised-seat clearance with your Maxi-Cosi is unmeasured.

access.detail: MY26 specifies three accessible rear tether positions. A related refreshed Epiq review confirms rear grab handles and loading lights; base-model child-loading with three installed restraints still needs a trial.
